nome_jp: 紺碧術者 フューチャー
testo:
Multi
Speed Attacker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, put the top card of your deck into your graveyard. If it's a spell, you may cast it for no cost.
Double Breaker
■ While this creature is in your deck, if you have a tooltip in the battle zone, this creature gets the light civilization.
